summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated shipped payload at install time
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit'})` against a package-shipped file. When Bun is already on PATH, `bun math_init.js` runs directly. The invoked `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line script marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a string-array rotation routine (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());...}`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with no source-readable behavior. Purpose declared in package metadata (description empty, no README shipped) does not require a second-runtime obfuscated init blob. This is an alternate-runtime dropper: a Node-based scanner cannot inspect the payload, and install-time execution is delegated to the freshly-downloaded Bun binary running an opaque 700 KB script. Package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope while CHANGELOG references a personal maintainer handle, and the code shape is anomalous for a ServiceTitan-branded API client regardless of whether the scope is legitimately controlled.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
